1306-2829-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1306-2829-5660-6769.description:
Cast Mana Crypt by paying its mana cost.
When Mana Crypt enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Mana Crypt by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Mana Crypt, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Ravager.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Mana Crypt from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

339-677-4885-8249.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

549-5226-6871--211.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the earthbend creature.
549-5226-6871--211.description:
Cast the earthbend creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Biotransference, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing the earthbent creature.
When the creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Biotransference, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Lithatog ability, giving Lithatog +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.
549-5226-6871--211.notes: Depending on the earthbend creature used, you may receive additional results. There may also be needed prerequisites that are specific for each card (such as Bumi, King of Three Trials which requires a Lesson in your graveyard).

141-728-1070.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-728-1070.description:
Cast Rise Again by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Rise Again.
Holding priority, activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Rise Again
Resolve the Rise Again copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

586-864-3125-5147-5631.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-3125-5147-5631.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Skeleton Crew.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Skeleton Crew trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

280-2438-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Golgari Rot Farm.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Golgari Rot Farm.
When Golgari Rot Farm dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Golgari Rot Farm from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

1017-2122-7741.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Wizard Class triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton due to Shang-Chi
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another Angel you control

1879-3259-4302-4509.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent is unable to block creatures you control.
You control an additional Angel.
1879-3259-4302-4509.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach it to another Angel you control, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
When the Angel dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token due to Divine Visitation.
When the Angel enters, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat each combat phase.

1170-2440-4758-7517.description:
Cast the copy of Aqueous Aria spell from exile by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, Displacer Kitten triggers, flickering Campus Composer, which enters prepared.
When Campus Composer enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding at least {C}.
Resolve the spell from step 1, creating a 3/3 Elemental creature token with flying.
When the token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Elemental you control.
Pay an additional {2}{U} to repeat steps 1 through 5 an additional time, this time adding {C}{C}{C} from the Mana Echoes triggers.
Pay an additional {1}{U} to repeat the loop again, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Pay an additional {U} to repeat the loop again, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Pay an additional {U} to repeat the loop again, adding six {C}.
Activate Crossroads Candleguide by paying {2}, adding one colored mana.
Repeat steps 1 through 5 and step 10 any number of times.
1170-2440-4758-7517.notes: Mana needed drops significantly for each additional Merfolk, Bard, and Elemental you control.

339-677-3967-7296.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3259-3263-5953-7296.easyPrerequisites: Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control.
3259-3263-5953-7296.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-3263-5953-7296.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Aya of Alexandria trigger.
Resolve the Aya of Alexandria trigger, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Etali, Primal Conqueror // Etali, Primal Sickness

4294-5220-5231.description:
Cast Etali by paying {5}{R}{R}.
When Etali enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Etali.
When Etali dies Mortuary triggers, putting Etali on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Thermopod ability from Step 3.
Resolve the Etali trigger from step 2, causing you to exile cards from each player's library until you exile a nonland card, with you exiling Etali from your library.
Cast Etali and any other nonland cards exiled this way without paying their mana costs.
Repeat from Step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5330-6972-7153.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing Arcbound Bruiser.
When Arcbound Bruiser dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Bruiser's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Bruiser from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.

719-1315-2366-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
719-1315-2366-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability.
Repeat from step 3.

647-2366-3430-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
647-2366-3430-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

539-5147-7035.description:
Cast Earthbending Student by paying its mana cost
When Earthbending Student enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Earthbending Student
When Earthbending Student dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Earthbending Student enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2034-4772-5220-5477-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-4772-5220-5477-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating two creature tokens and putting two +1/+1 counters on each Plant you control.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

826-1636-4050-6935.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's second ability by tapping it, causing Otherworldly Escort to lose all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Otherworldly Escort.
When Otherworldly Escort dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Spirit Detective.
When Otherworldly Escort enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1850-4426-6620.description:
Activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing a land.
Play the land from your graveyard.
Repeat.
1850-4426-6620.notes: If the land can tap for mana once it enters the battlefield, you can do so for infinite mana.

643-4394-5231-5470.description:
Cast Everquill Phoenix for its mutate cost by paying {3}{R}, putting it under or over a non-Human creature you control.
Everquill Phoenix triggers, creating a Feather artifact token.
Cast Maskwood Nexus by paying {4}.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Feather token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Ghired, adding {R}.
Activate a Feather by paying {1} and sacrificing it, returning Ghired from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.

1170-2478-6643.easyPrerequisites: You have not cast a spell using Edgar this turn if Mishra's Bauble is in your graveyard.
1170-2478-6643.description:
Cast Mishra's Bauble from your hand or graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Edgar.
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1477-1913-2073--90.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing the artifact with mana value 1 or less.
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning the artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Imotekh's first ability triggers, creating two 2/2 Necron Warrior artifact creature tokens.
When the Necron Warriors enter the battlefield, Salvaging Station triggers twice, untapping Salvaging Station.
Repeat.

1669-5145-5147-5466.description:
Cast Rakdos Joins Up by paying {3}{B}{R}.
When Rakdos Joins Up enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thaumatog by sacrificing Rakdos Joins Up.
Resolve the Rakdos Joins Up ability, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
When Archon of Falling Stars enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
Resolve the Archon of Falling Stars ability, returning Rakdos Joins Up from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1477-2558-5346-5433.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Crime Novelist and Krenko trigger.
Resolve the Crime Novelist trigger, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on the Crime Novelist.
Resolve the Krenko trigger, causing you to pay {R} to create a 1/1 Goblin creature token with haste.
When the Goblin enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Goblin token.
Resolve the Extruder ability from step 1.
Repeat.

957-1309-1987-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
957-1309-1987-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your first extra turn.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Salvager of Secrets.
When Salvager of Secrets and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Salvager of Secrets trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Time Stretch from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Stretch during your draw step.
Repeat.

1116-1829-3240-5670.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1116-1829-3240-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by sacrificing Nether Traitor and paying 1 life.
When Nether Traitor dies, Vindictive Vampire and Sek'Kuar trigger.
Resolve the Vindictive Vampire trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Sek'Kuar trigger, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Graveborn.
When the Graveborn dies, Vindictive Vampire and Nether Traitor trigger.
Resolve the Vindictive Vampire trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Nether Traitor trigger, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

997-2082-4186.easyPrerequisites: Sadistic Glee attached to Scurry Oak.
997-2082-4186.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature
997-2082-4186.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies, Sadisitc Glee triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

1121-4095-5715.manaNeeded: {7}{U}{U}{R}{R}{R}{R} plus enough mana to cast the additional instant or sorcery
1121-4095-5715.notablePrerequisites: You have an additional instant and/or sorcery card in hand that has a single target
1121-4095-5715.description:
Cast the additional instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost, targeting a single target.
Holding priority, cast Radiate by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting that instant or sorcery.
Holding priority, cast Word of Seizing by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any permanent.
Holding priority, activate Mischievous Quanar's morph ability by paying {1}{U}{U}, turning it face-up.
Mischievous Quanar triggers, copying Radiate, targeting Word of Seizing.
Resolve the copy of Radiate, creating a copy of Word of Seizing targeting each other permanent.
Resolve all Word of Seizings, causing you to gain control of all permanents on the battlefield, and give them all haste until end of turn.

1927-3765-5063.description:
Cast Voldaren Epicure by paying {R}.
When Voldaren Epicure enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, cast Worldfire by paying {6}{R}{R}{R}, exiling all permanents, all cards in all hands and graveyards, and setting each player's life total to one.
Resolve the Voldran Epicure trigger from step 2, creating a Blood token and dealing one damage to each opponent.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

654-2653-2893-4500.notablePrerequisites: Fertilid has 2 or more +1/+1 counters on it.
654-2653-2893-4500.description:
Activate Fertilid, searching your library for a basic land card, putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
When it enters the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor, Retreat to Kazandu and Nissa trigger.
Amulet of Vigor's trigger resolves, untapping the land.
Nissa's trigger resolves, adding {G}.
Retreat to Kazandu's trigger resolves, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Repeat.

914-5003-5147.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-5003-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist.
When Dockside Extortionist dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least four Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Repeat.
If opponents control five or more artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.

4365-4871-5189.notablePrerequisites: Ghave has at least two +1/+1 counters on it, or there is a +1/+1 counter on another creature you control.
4365-4871-5189.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Ghave ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

1456-4929-5220.description:
Cast Cryptic Trilobite either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Cryptic Trilobite enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Cryptic Trilobite on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

1456-1976-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

3018-3317-4050.description:
Cast Rancor by paying {G}, attaching it to any other creature you control.
When Rancor enters, Historian's Boon triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature with Rancor attached, adding {G}.
Rancor triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1339-1940-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-1940-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Liliana, Dreadhorde General triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Repeat.

1987-2510-2556-4792.notablePrerequisites: Any instant exiled by Semblance Anvil.
1987-2510-2556-4792.description:
Activate Paradise Plume by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Paradise Plume and Mnemonic Wall, blinking them as well as triggering Paradise Plume to gain you 1 life.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Paradise Plume enters the battlefield, choose "blue".
Repeat.

3705-4050-4191.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Squee, adding one mana of any color.
Cast Squee from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
